name: Fujibo Holdings, Inc.
summary: Fujibo Holdings, Inc., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells polishing pads, industrial chemical products, and apparel products in Japan and internationally. The company operates through three Abrasives Business, Chemical Industrial Products Business, and Life Clothing Business segments. It provides POLYPAS polishing pads for precision polishing of silicon wafers, as well as for various types of semiconductor materials, metals, and glasses; fine chemical intermediates, spinning, textiles and apparel; and functional non-woven fabrics, functional films, non-woven polyester fabrics and artificial leathers.
